title: Generic micro servo: anatomy
label: Generic micro servo, illustrative, not measured, not a named product
provenance: scripted in Blender 5.2.2, generic, not measured

budget.status: provisional: re-check on the real Android phone before page integration (Lucky, 16 Oct 2026)

shaft_axis.origin: every part's origin lies on the output-shaft axis (x = 0, z = 0 in glTF), at the part's lowest point

parts.name: Output horn and screw
parts.role: Carries the load: the arm or linkage bolts to it; the screw holds it on the splined shaft.

parts.name: Upper case
parts.role: Holds the gear train; the mounting ears bolt the servo down; the boss guides the output shaft.

parts.name: Gear train
parts.role: Trades speed for torque: a small motor pinion drives larger gears, stage by stage, to the splined output shaft.

parts.name: Motor and position sensor
parts.role: The motor turns fast with little torque; the potentiometer on the output shaft tells the board the angle.

parts.name: Control board and bottom cover
parts.role: The board compares the commanded angle with the sensor and drives the motor; the cover closes the case.

exceptions.why: a motor can reads as metal; approved exception to the palette (Lucky, 16 Oct 2026)

gear_train.label: illustrative example values, not measured
gear_train.ratio_note: derived by code from the tooth counts (driven ÷ driver per mesh); never typed by hand
gear_train.accuracy: involute flanks approximated with a few points; no backlash, profile shift or tolerance; for looks only

teaches_note: teaches lists concept IDs in content/robotics/concepts.json; teaches_proposed are in the M4 concept graph plan, not yet in concepts.json
